fields.Name: C2 -> S1.2
fields.Description: Gate G2.21 (phase 2, dataset C2, criterion S1.2): on C2 with a declared capacity of 150 reviews a year, precision among the top-scored claims is reported with its 95% interval (value inside it) beside the holdout base rate 151/7,500, 1 of 1. It fails when the trainer result omits precision at capacity (not reported).

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: Precision at a capacity of 150 a year is reported with its 95% interval beside the base rate 151/7,500 (1 of 1 pytest case passes).
